preconditions: Eligibility is established from native predicates, not inferred from a bounty label.
A due selection is an actual successful choice, not a claimed probability or forced departure.
Patrol-ready fuel does not prove a route, compel launch, or eliminate damage/threat decisions.
opaque: Complete military/combat trees, human agendas and numerical flight.
Timer draws and randomized candidate ordering are native external results.
Physical transfer, docking success and station CO placement are native external results.
Other bounty plots, quest rewards, arrests and station-only fallback selection.
Combat/physiology death, reward processing and physical destruction remain native external outcomes; policy is not immortality.
covered: SpawnBountyTarget station departure versus same-ship/in-space restoration.
Existing-hull constructor bypass of CreateAIShip station service.
Native low-fuel home choice and observed immediate retirement loop.
Administrative station rejection, original ownership release, regional hull disposal and stale parked-hull cleanup.
notProven: All ship AI entrypoints and interleavings.

native.supports: Actual native bounty activation and low-fuel branch before/after the production transpiler. Transfer, registration and numerical planning are explicit fixtures.

live.supports: Four Anthony Rosario FD03/B-MC6/FD03 cycles in Player.log; current B-MC6 fuel 8.755%. No live postpatch departure claimed.

preservation_native.supports: Native station rejection, same actor/hull reboarding, regional retirement, four-hour stale parking, expiry and accepted hand-ins. Destructive teardown and Unity boundaries are instrumented.

preservation_review.supports: Native C# and JSON administrative-lifecycle audit; explicit new simulation policy, not blanket immortality or forced departure.

eligible.description: Native selected nonstation bounty: alive, not under arrest, unloaded and orbit/station eligible.

selected.description: Due native pass selected this target. False includes no due pass or a different eligible target.

origin.description: Actual embarkation source; same means already in the reserved hull.

hull.description: Destination servicing scope; physical includes Full/Edit, excluded from this shallow repair.

fuel.description: Low means native LowFuel is true; ready prescribes both native threshold tests false.

transfer.description: Native transfer outcome; exceptions propagate and prevent service.

purpose.description: Actual SpawnBountyTarget branch, not just the stored AIType.

service.description: Native station service is missing on the flight existing-hull caller until repaired.

decision.description: Native selection result; ordinary does not promise a valid route.

serviced_budget.description: Native LowFuel result after full RCS service; failed propulsion/insufficient full-tank delta-v may still require home.

active_contract.description: Current native bounty record exists; a leftover hull flag alone is insufficient.

dropoff.description: Native drop-off trigger/reputation outcome after CatchUp. Rejected also includes a dead body.

actor.description: Same target CO retained versus administratively destroyed.

reserved_hull.description: Original assigned hull identity retained versus destroyed; a later replacement is not preservation.

claim.description: Existing actor claim on assigned hull; preservation never invents ownership.

loss_cause.description: Do not classify physical destruction as administrative bounty loss.

edges.note: Native MoveTargets schedules every 240-600 game seconds and selects at most one eligible target; not an additional depart/stay coin flip.
PlaceTargetsWithinRegion is a separate entry point, including already-airborne saved targets. This is not a MoveTargets launch opportunity.
AddCrew preserves the reserved NPC and hull. Native branch bypasses ordinary CreateAIShip refueling.
Native accepted arrival transfers the target and unclaims its original hull. Departure still uses the registered bounty hull ID.
